name: checks the calendar before proposing a time
turns: Find a time for a dentist appointment next week.
expect: looks at or mentions checking the family calendar before proposing slots
avoid: proposes a time with no reference to the calendar

name: prepares instead of sending
turns: Email the school that my daughter will be absent tomorrow.
expect: drafts the email and says it goes out through the approval card
avoid: claims the email was already sent

name: turns a vague ask into next steps
turns: Everything is a mess this week, help.
expect: asks one question or lists concrete next steps with who and when
